ref2va_prompt_template_en.subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the user's real household pet in <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> is the sole identity source for the pet's visible species and breed traits, face shape, eyes, ears, coat colors and markings, tail, body proportions, age impression, and any existing collar or clothing.
<Subject 2> is the home environment in <Picture 2>. <Picture 2> is the sole reference for the scene layout, structures, furnishings, surfaces, materials, lighting direction, perspective, safe activity area, props, and 16:9 composition.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.summary: [reference generation] The target video is a seamless {duration}-second photorealistic live desktop wallpaper showing <Subject 1> playing gently inside <Subject 2>. The pet identity from <Picture 1> and the complete environment from <Picture 2> remain consistent throughout one continuous locked-off shot, with a loop-friendly return to the opening state.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the pet's exact visible identity, species and breed traits, face, eyes, ears, coat colors and markings, tail, body proportions, age impression, and existing accessories without redesign, beautification, duplication, or identity drift.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the referenced room or outdoor-home layout, architecture, furniture, props, materials, perspective, lighting direction, safe boundaries, and 16:9 composition without replacement, relocation, warping, or added people or animals.
ref2va_prompt_template_en.detailed_description:
The target video uses natural photorealism, physically plausible motion, stable fine detail, and calm desktop-wallpaper pacing. It lasts exactly {duration} seconds and contains one uninterrupted shot.
[Shot 1] A wide, eye-level 16:9 view reproduces <Subject 2> from <Picture 2> with the same camera position, lens perspective, spatial relationships, surface textures, prop placement, light direction, shadow softness, and clear central activity area. {setting_notes} <Subject 1> from <Picture 1> is naturally integrated at believable scale on the central ground plane. Its face, eye color, ear shape, coat pattern boundaries, tail, proportions, age impression, and any existing collar or clothing remain visually identical to the reference. Fur or feathers retain fine texture without smoothing or cosmetic redesign. The pet has realistic weight, stable anatomy, correct limb count for its species, firm ground contact, and soft contact shadows that match <Subject 2>.
The action unfolds as a single gentle cycle: {action} Movement remains low to moderate, species-appropriate, continuous, and safe. Paws or feet plant and lift naturally; the torso, head, ears, tail, and coat follow with subtle secondary motion. Props react only through plausible contact and never teleport, multiply, float, or pass through the pet. During the final second, <Subject 1> returns close to its opening position, facing direction, silhouette, and calm pose, while any named toy or movable prop returns close to its initial place. Scene illumination and environmental motion also converge toward the opening state, creating a clean visual loop.
The camera is perfectly locked with no cut, zoom, pan, tilt, roll, shake, reframing, lens breathing, or focus pumping. Keep <Subject 1> fully within the safe central area and leave calm visual space near the frame edges for desktop icons. Only the pet, named toy, and scene-appropriate small ambient elements such as curtains, leaves, rain, snow, plants, or firelight may move subtly. Do not introduce people, another animal, a duplicate pet, new accessories, new furniture, or unrequested objects. Prevent morphing, coat-pattern drift, facial drift, extra or fused limbs, floating paws, sudden scale changes, texture crawling, scene warping, flicker, strobing, captions, visible text, logos, and watermarks. {extra_direction}
ref2va_prompt_template_en.overall_soundscape: Extremely subtle scene-appropriate room tone or outdoor ambience continues throughout, with soft pet-safe foley synchronized to footfalls and gentle toy contact. No voices, speech, barking, meowing, loud impacts, or distracting sound effects.
